notes.title: CardScrawl 1.0 Launch: Full Release is Here!
notes.notes:
CardScrawl 1.0 is now live!
The game has officially left Early Access. Version 1.0 includes final polish, quality-of-life improvements, and several bug fixes to ensure a smoother and more consistent experience.

Thank you to everyone who played and provided feedback during development. We hope you enjoy the full release. We'll continue supporting the game with future updates and bug fixes as needed.

The 1.0 Release Patch Notes are below:


General Improvements

Enchantment Descriptions: All enchantments now use "Equipped creature" wording for naming consistency.

Stone Skin & Haste: Fixed incorrect description text being displayed.

AP Regen Status Bar Text: "Ap Recharge" has been renamed to "Ap Regen" for consistency in the status bar.

Visual Clarity & Input Polish

Creature Mouseover Highlight: Hovering over creatures now uses a distinct selector color for improved visual feedback.

Equip Target Selector (Controller/Keyboard): When equipping a creature, a selector now appears over the target for clearer targeting.

Mouse & Keyboard Improvements:

The mouse no longer shows the equipment icon over invalid tiles or already-equipped creatures.

This also resolves an issue where the mouse would override keyboard input in mixed control use, resulting in smoother, more intuitive hybrid input behavior.

Tutorial Polish

Creature Unsummon SFX: Added sound effects when creatures are unsummoned for better consistency in the tutorial.

Champion Unlock Fixes

Unlock Bug Resolution: Champions affected by the earlier unlock bug (fixed in RC1.1) should now be unlocked correctly.
(Note: Anyone playing RC1.1 or newer is not affected.)

Unlock UI Update: Champion unlock conditions now display full descriptions instead of just achievement names. Progress trackers have also been added for those unlocked via in-game criteria.



Please check out the basic "How A Match Works" video below:

notes.title: Full Release Coming July 17
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,


We're excited to officially announce that the full release of the game is coming on July 17.


As we approach this milestone, we want to take a moment to say thank you to everyone who has been part of the journey so far.


This game began as a passion project between two developers who had an idea for a tactical experience that felt different. After countless iterations and experiments, we finally found the version that clicked. It may not be perfect, but we believe it offers something truly unique, and we hope you enjoy what we’ve built.


Internally, we refer to this genre as a "Scrawl-like". It features creatures that move automatically, with strategy emerging from resource management, positioning, and planning several moves ahead, similar to chess. The concept is loosely inspired by the Hero Line War custom maps from the old Warcraft modding scene, as well as Phantasy Star Online Episode 3: C.A.R.D. Revolution, which blended card mechanics with tactical board control. While this chapter is nearing its end, we are already thinking about how this idea could evolve in the future.


To everyone who tested the game, provided feedback, streamed it, or supported us during Early Access, thank you. Your input helped shape the game in meaningful ways.


At this point, we've implemented and refined most of the features we originally envisioned, along with many that came directly from community feedback. The game is in a place we're proud of, and we’re excited to share it with even more players.


That said, this is not the end. We will continue to support the game going forward, and we have one more update planned. It may even arrive before the official release on July 17. Beyond that, we also plan to support the game with bug fixes, balance tweaks, and general maintenance to ensure the experience stays smooth for all players.


Thank you again for all your support. 


Mire Studios

notes.title: RC 1 Update - Gameplay, Visual, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
RC 1 Update - Gameplay, Visual, and Bug Fixes
We are excited to release our first Release Candidate for the game. This marks a major milestone as we focus on refining gameplay, improving clarity, and resolving remaining issues as we move toward a full release. Thank you for all your feedback and support as we continue to polish the game.
Champion Changes
Battle Knight Wonder: Fixed an issue where the opponent's ability would damage their own creatures (Player version was correct).

Nocturne: Opponent's creatures without enchantments are now darkened, as they cannot be targeted.

Valeena: Ability effect no longer plays on creatures without enchantments (visual fix only).

Koross: All tiles other than opponent's creatures are now darkened during ability targeting.

Immolator:

Fixed an issue where creatures summoned after casting the ability would not receive the correct power bonus.

Ability is now usable during the Summon Phase to prevent unintended gameplay interactions.

Cat Kaiser:

Ability would incorrectly skip the movement phase if a creature advance occurred. This has been corrected.

Visuals for the extra combat phase have been corrected to accurately reflect gameplay.
Enchantment and Board Changes
Arcane Aberration: Ability has been reworked to create Manaburn Sigils on the board that deal damage based on a creature's mana cost. These sigils cannot be overridden by Flame or Stone Sigils for their duration and pierce Enchantment Immunity. The pattern appears staggered across the board depending on whether the player or opponent casts it.

Flame Sigil:

Damage text now displays the actual damage amount instead of showing it as a percentage.

Enchantment Immunity: All text and phase names updated for consistency.

Green Cast Arrow Sprite: Corrected visual issue with the casting arrow.
General Gameplay Improvements
Summon and Action Phases have been reworked so that the opponent completes all of their actions first, followed by the player. This change allows players to better react to the opponent and streamlines gameplay. We also thinks this makes the game more enjoyable.

Added additional polish to ability mouseovers for champions such as Zod.

Flashing Border for Enchantments: Creatures with enchantments that are on a 1-turn cooldown now have a flashing border, indicating they will cast their enchantment this turn.

Phase name updated for consistency ("Casting Spell Immunity" is now "Casting Enchantment Immunity").
Tutorial and UI Changes
The Help menu can no longer be opened during tutorials via the pause menu.

Advanced View Mode Tutorial: Now forces Advanced View to be active for consistency. A disclaimer is shown at the start.

Combat Round Order Tutorial: Updated with examples that reflect recent visual changes such as the flashing border behavior.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where some opponents (such as Zod and Valeena) would incorrectly use their abilities when they would have no effect.

Corrected selector placement in the Advanced Board View Tutorial to prevent overlapping important information.

Resolved a bug where using player abilities during the Summon Phase with a full board could cause the ability to fail and the turn to pass to the opponent.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for playing and for all the feedback as we head toward a full release. The development team is continuing to work on additional polish and visual improvements in the coming weeks.

notes.title: EA 11 Patch – Smarter Help, Better Clarity, Cleaner Play
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – EA 11

Casual Mode: Player’s champion ability power is now halved to allow more frequent use and better pacing.

Help Sheet: Now includes discard phase info and explains that discarding is optional.

Help Sheet: Now accessible in the pause menu.

Creatures: Removed flavor text from creature card mouseover to reduce confusion.

Tutorials Menu: Fixed an issue where the return button couldn’t be selected using a controller or keyboard.

Tutorial Descriptions: Each tutorial now shows estimated time to complete.

Fixed some typos

Creature Mouseover: “Spell Immune” status has been renamed to “Enchant Immune” for consistency.

Advanced Board View Tutorial: Fixed a selector UI issue that was obscuring creature info.

Cat Kaiser: New visual effect added when casting the ability.

Tutorials Button: Now flashes to draw attention.

Thanks as always for your support!

We’re continuing work on visual polish and clarity improvements to make your experience smoother every patch.

notes.title: EA 10 Update – Tower Lord Visuals & New Tutorial
notes.notes:
Visuals

Added a new  unique background when fighting the Tower Lord

Ability usage effects are now much more noticeable than before. This will be adjusted further in future updates.

Champion Fixes & Adjustments

Cat Kaiser: Fixed an issue where using the ability always gave the player the next action, regardless of proper turn order. (This bug only affected the player; the opponent version was working correctly.)

Salvatore: Ability now always deals at least 1 damage. This issue was only noticeable on the early floors but has now been fixed.

Brute: Fixed an issue where the Opponent Brute’s ability would incorrectly target all creatures, including allies, in its vertical line of effect.

Wretched Cretin & Nocturne: These champions were mistakenly using the same ability animation. Each now uses a unique one.

Gameplay

Rivals: Some champions did not have their correct rivals during a run. This has now been corrected.

Tutorial

A new Combat Round Order tutorial has been added to help players better understand how combat phase order works.

Thank you all for your support! We are actively working on additional visual polish and more updates to improve clarity and gameplay.

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 9 Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Visual Clarity & UI Improvements

Enhanced Readability
•	Tutorial Improvements: Status Effects, How To Read Cards, and Target Types tutorials now highlight relevant elements for much clearer learning
•	Selector Borders: Added visual borders throughout the game when summoning, equipping, and targeting for better board readability
•	Combat Clarity: Creatures attacking each other now display selector borders, and arrows appear above creatures casting enchantments
•	Target Information: Enhanced target pattern displays during combat and when hovering over creatures

Menu & Interface
•	Settings Menu: Fixed issue where Settings and Help menus could incorrectly open simultaneously
•	Save Data Display: Improved readability of save prompts and fixed incorrect difficulty/floor information display
•	Tutorial Progress: Added progress indicator on the Status Bar during tutorials
•	Advanced Tooltips: More champion abilities now show detailed target information when hovering

Gameplay & Balance Changes

Core Mechanics
•	Starting Enchantment Deck: Normalized to be consistent across all runs for better early game balance
•	Round Rewards: Reordered end-of-round rewards - Spoils now come first, followed by card selection
•	Spell Immunity: Renamed to "Enchantment Immunity" for consistency

Champion Abilities
•	Audio: Fixed missing sound effects for Cat Kaiser, Nocturne, and Rock and Roll Troll abilities
•	Visual Effects: Restored missing visual effects for Dracarath's champion ability
•	Targeting: Improved ability targeting for Brute when using a controller/keyboard
•	Animation Speed: Updated ability animation timing for Wonder, Brute, Zod, Koross, and Nocturne

Bug Fixes

Audio & Visual
•	Ghost Cards: Fixed sounds playing when player was out of cards
•	Music System: Resolved issue where pausing/resuming caused looping instead of track progression
•	Creature Cards: Corrected power and mana color display on inactive creature cards
•	Spoils Display: Fixed rare spoils showing incorrect information on mouseover

Gameplay
•	Chaos Hardcore: Removed incorrect save file prompts and updated mode description to clarify no saving is allowed
•	Oni: Now correctly inherits Tower Lord's first ability for the match (wasn't getting an ability before).
•	Tutorial Descriptions: Updated to clarify they're best viewed after playing at least one match

Interface
•	Ability Buttons: Active ability border now disappears on mouseover to match opponent behavior
•	Enchantment Targeting: Improved clarity when using targeting abilities by hiding conflicting target information whenever using Character Abilities that select a target(s) (Brute, Koross, etc.).

Thank you for your continued support during Early Access! Happy dungeon crawling!

The CardScrawl Team

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 8 Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Scrawlers,

Today’s EA 8 update brings one of our biggest batches of changes yet. We’ve overhauled the tutorial system, added a challenging new game mode, cleaned up visuals, fixed several ability issues, and made important balance adjustments. This patch should make everything from onboarding to high-level play feel smoother and more rewarding.

New Game Mode: Amplify Trial
The experimental Tower of Eternity has been shelved—it didn’t meet our standards for long-term fun. In its place, we’ve added Amplify Trial, a fresh mode that gives you rare spoils after every fight to let your builds ramp faster. But beware: enemy scaling is even more brutal than Chaos Gauntlet.

Tutorial Rework + Quick Rules
The old tutorial was bloated and overwhelming. We’ve now split it into smaller, easier-to-digest sections that focus on only the most important mechanics. This should help both new and returning players get up to speed without wading through too much text.

Gameplay & Balance Improvements

Combat Round Order Tweaked: APDegeneration now resolves after APRegeneration, allowing more consistent ability use.

Several champion abilities (like Grovekeeper, Salvatore De Mort, Drel, and Bulwark) now provide real-time number previews or improved targeting clarity.

Random “target” types on starting deck enchantments have been weakened for balance.

Damage enchantment in starting decks has been tuned.

Level 1 AP Regen/Degen cooldowns standardized to 1 turn (no more 3-turn waits).

Cat Kaiser, Wonder, Bulwark, and others now highlight valid targets when casting abilities.

Visual, UI & Audio Tweaks

Updated animations for card draw, ability activation, and summon selection

Ability bar now flashes when ready

New sound effects for card movements, Flame Sigil, and more

Better readability for combat tooltips and numbers on abilities

Mouseovers added for lane power and deck indicators

Health bar, ability icons, and FX tweaks to Wretched Cretin, Weeping Maiden, and others

Misc Fixes & Updates

Narrator voice lines refreshed

Vampiric Strike effect position fixed

Help button removed from tutorial

The current floor text now displays the maximum amount of floors on the game board

The current game mode now displays on the game board

All Champion lore and endgame text updated

Thank you, as always, for your continued support and bug reports. EA 8 makes CardScrawl cleaner, clearer, and more challenging—and we’re already working on what’s next.

See you in the Amplify Trial... if you dare.

— The Mire Studios Team

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 7 Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Scrawlers,

Our latest update, EA 7, is here—and it’s focused on making your time in the Chaos Tower smoother, clearer, and a bit more fair.

Here’s what’s new:

Quick Rules Page Added
We’ve introduced a Quick Rules page for players who want a fast and accessible way to learn the core mechanics without committing to the full tutorial. You can access it anytime via the new HELP button on the game board. First-time players will now see the Quick Rules instead of being prompted for the full tutorial.

Ability Feedback Improvements

The ability bar now flashes when a champion ability is ready to use during the summon or action phase depending on when your Champion Ability is useable.

The current game mode is now displayed during runs under the floors/turns display.

Kozikth's ability now shows an icon over the first selected target for better clarity.

Cat Kaiser now targets a single allied Creature of your choice rather than all.

Cat Kaiser Stat Adjustment: +10 starting HP and 10 less maximum AP.

UI/UX Enhancements

Glyphs (controller prompts) are now properly displayed in the settings menu when cycling through windows with keyboard/controller.

The Settings Menu "Board View Type" description has been updated to clarify that bumpers toggle between info panels in Simple mode.

The Player's and Opponent's Creature and Enchantment Hands now fade out when they’re not usable—still hoverable, just clearer. This should greatly reduce bloat and make the UI much more clear for new players.

As always, thank you for your support and feedback! Every bit of it helps us improve the game and make CardScrawl the best it can be.

See you in the arena—and don’t forget to try the new Quick Rules if you're showing the game to a friend!

— The Mire Studios Team

notes.title: EA 5 Update – Achievement Fixes, New Enchantments, and More!
notes.notes:
Hey duelists,

We’ve just launched the EA 5 Update for CardScrawl! This update is packed with meaningful improvements to achievements, gameplay balance, and the save system. Let’s get into it:

🏆 Achievement & Unlock Fixes
The Enchanting Mastery achievement was missing and has now been added. Valeena is now unlockable!

The following achievements now properly unlock their Champions:
Mana Burnout, Feywild Pact, Mana Master, Direct Assault, Flawless Victory, Forged in Stone, Demoncaller, Graveborn Army, Full Summon

Save system updated: Characters now unlock immediately and consistently.

🧩 Achievement Difficulty Rebalancing
To give players clearer progression, we’ve reorganized which difficulties certain achievements require:

Now unlockable on any difficulty:
Novice Duelist, Mana Master, Direct Assault, Full Summon, Creature Collector, Forged in Stone, Demoncaller, Graveborn Army, Feywild Pact, Mana Burnout, Enchanting Mastery, Champion's Journey

Now require Classic Ascent or higher:
Trial By Fire, Swift Victory, Underdog Victory, Overkill, Chain Reaction, Champion’s Edge, Legendary Summoner, Overwhelming Force, Legendary Slayer, Card Shark, Flawless Victory, Resourceful, Defender of the Tower, Decked Out, Out of Options

Require Chaos Gauntlet or higher:
Rising Challenger, Tower Explorer, Master of The Tower

Require Chaos Hardcore:
Unyielding Will

Creature Collector requirement increased: 15 → 30 creatures.

Overwhelming Force: Now requires 9 creatures on the board at once (up from 6).

🧪 Gameplay Changes & Balancing
Charm nerfed: Charmed creatures no longer deal direct damage when reaching the board's end—they return to their original summoner instead.

Heal Enchantment removed: It was underperforming and has been retired.

Double Strike removed: Too similar to First Strike, so we've cut it to reduce bloat.

New Enchantments Added:

Vampiric Strike: Creatures with this permanent enchantment heal for its value when they deal melee damage.

APDegeneration: A counter to APRegeneration—it drains enemy Ability Power each round.

✨ Visuals, Effects, and Feedback
New FX for Dracarath and Ratburg when using their Champion Abilities.

New Game Board font – Easier to read and much cleaner!

Combat Round Order changed:

Stone Sigil casts first now—before Silence.

APDegeneration now casts right after APRegeneration.

Announcer setting now has an audio cue when toggled in settings.

⚠️ Important Save Note
Due to these updates, old save files are incompatible and will be deleted when you launch the new version. However, your achievements and unlocks will carry over just fine. You’ll be right back in the climb.

As always, thank you for playing and sharing your feedback—it truly helps shape CardScrawl’s development. This update lays the groundwork for even more content and polish coming soon!

See you in the arena,
—The Mire Studios Team

notes.title: Larger Update in the Works!
notes.notes:

notes.title: EA 4 – Save Settings, Bug Fixes & Improved Visual Feedback
notes.notes:
Duelists, prepare for battle!

We’re back with EA 4, bringing more polish, improved mechanics, and crucial bug fixes to CardScrawl. This update includes:

✅ Saved Settings – All settings are now saved automatically, so your preferences will persist between play sessions. (Note: If you have an existing save file, you may need to tweak your settings back to your liking.)

✅ Creature Advance Fix – We’ve fixed an issue where the Creature Advance mechanic failed to trigger properly when creatures were affected by the Bless Enchantment.

✅ Improved Summon Visual Feedback – It’s now easier to see which creatures can be enchanted, with clearer visual feedback when equipping summons.

✅ Vigor Infusion Spoil Fix – The Vigor Infusion rare spoil description now correctly displays the actual HP it provides: 15 HP (instead of the incorrect 20 HP).

✅ Nocturne Ability Icon Fix – Nocturne’s ability icon now properly displays when using his ability.

✅ Stone Spikes Renamed – The enchantment formerly known as Stone Spikes has been renamed to Stone Sigil for a more fitting and thematic name.

⚙️ Crash Fix – Thanks to a report from one of our forum members (and their helpful video recording), we’ve squashed a crash bug. Keep the feedback coming—it makes a difference!

🔥 What’s next?
We’re hard at work on EA 5, which will bring even more content, improvements, and fixes. Stay tuned for details!

🃏 Thank you for playing CardScrawl! See you in the arena!

notes.title: EA 3 Update – Status Effects Overhaul & Expanded Settings!
notes.notes:
Duelists, a new update has arrived!

EA 3 brings a wave of improvements to CardScrawl, making battles easier to read, settings more customizable, and mechanics clearer than ever. Let’s dive into what’s new!

🛠 Status Effect Overhaul – Better Clarity at a Glance!
No more guessing what effects are active—status effects now change the color of a creature’s board tile, giving you instant visual feedback:

Silence – Teal
Double Strike – Red
First Strike – Orange
Root – Green
Spell Immunity – Yellow
Charm – Pink
Additionally, status effect icons in the order panel now feature their corresponding colors on the sides for quick reference!

⚙️ Expanded Settings Menu – More Control Over Your Game!
We’ve expanded the settings menu and organized options into dedicated tabs. New adjustable settings include:
✅ Screen Camera Shake – Toggle screen shake when taking or receiving direct damage
✅ Screen Color Flash – Toggle screen flash effects when taking or receiving direct damage (Now disabled by default)
✅ SFX Volume – Adjust sound effects and narrator volume
✅ Music Volume – Adjust game music volume
✅ Window Render Resolution – Change game window render resolution

Bonus: Your settings for Screen Camera Shake and Screen Color Flash are now saved between sessions!

🎭 Scum’s Ability – New Visual Feedback!
Scum’s ability now provides clear visual feedback—any creature affected will transform into a Festering Abomination. This doesn’t change how the ability functions, but it ensures you always know when Scum has done his work. The ability’s description has also been updated for clarity.

📜 Additional Fixes & Changes:
- Updated Stone Skin and Berserk descriptions to better reflect their effects.
- Shortened Fortune enchantment description for better readability.
- Mouse can now be used to clear the "Press Any Button" prompt on the main menu.
- Game Credits updated.
This update focuses on quality-of-life improvements, making CardScrawl more intuitive and user-friendly while keeping the core strategy intact. Let us know what you think in the discussions!

🔥 Play CardScrawl now in Early Access! 🔥

notes.title: CardScrawl EA 1 – Combat Overhaul & Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Greetings, duelists!

Our first Early Access update, EA 1, has arrived! This update brings key improvements to combat visibility, audio fixes, and smoother card transitions to enhance your experience in the Chaos Tower.

EA 1 Patch Notes:
✅ Overhauled Combat View – It’s now much easier to see what’s happening during the combat round!
✅ Fixed Audio Fading Bug – Music no longer fades out when defeating an opponent (this was only supposed to happen when losing).
✅ No More Tutorial Retries – Restarting in the tutorial has been removed.
✅ Card Drawing Transitions Tweaked – Minor tweaks to card animations during both Discard phases.
✅ Updated Build Text on Main Menu – Small polish to keep things clear.

We’re committed to improving CardScrawl with each update, and your feedback is invaluable! Let us know what you think in:

💬 Steam Discussions
🐦 X Account

Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates!

🔥 See you in the Chaos Tower! 🔥
